svg.title: The best published energies, by system size
svg.desc: Number of sites (x) against relative gap to the exact ground-state energy (y, inverted log scale, better is higher) for 410 published energies on 229 exactly solved instances.
svg.text: The best published energies, by system size
410 energies on the 229 instances that have an exact ground-state energy, placed by their relative gap to it so that different
Hamiltonians share one axis; a better energy is higher. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones
relative gap to the instance's exact energy (better is higher)
Height is |E − E_exact| / |E_exact| on an inverted log scale, so that a better energy is higher; 34 rows closer than 10⁻⁸, above or below, sit on
the exact line. A row below the exact energy within twice the error bar is placed by the size of its gap. 8 rows lie below the exact energy by
more than twice the error bar and are not drawn. No line joins the sizes: the instances at one size are different Hamiltonians, and a frontier
across them would compare a Hubbard energy with a Heisenberg one. Exact references are exact diagonalization or sign-problem-free QMC,
exact within its error bar; flagged rows are not shown.
